subject: Joint POC: pgvector on‑prem + S3 cold tiering — billing & ops proposal
messages:
From: Ben Andrews <ben@vectorspring.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 14:05:00 +0000
Subject: Joint POC: pgvector on-prem + S3 cold tiering — initial ask

Hey Marcus,

Thanks again for the intro earlier this month. VectorSpring is keen to run a joint proof-of-concept that shows Redwood Private + our on-prem pgvector connector working with an S3 cold-tier spillover for infrequent vectors. The ask from our ops/legal teams is twofold:

1) Confirm Redwood can support an on-prem deployment model that keeps vectors on customer-controlled hardware while allowing S3 cold-tiering for snapshots (data residency controls + encryption-at-rest).
2) Agree commercial basics for a co-sell pilot: a 6-week POC, split of pilot credits (we propose 60/40 VectorSpring/Redwood), and a single consolidated invoice for third-party storage costs.

I've attached a short scope doc (vspoc_scope.pdf) and a sample commercial note. Can we get a quick alignment call this week? Sandeep (cc'd) will be the technical lead from our side.

Best,
Ben
Founder, VectorSpring
ben@vectorspring.com
+1 415 555 0112

Attachment: vspoc_scope.pdf (PDF, 210KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Andrews <ben@vectorspring.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Joint POC: pgvector on-prem + S3 cold tiering — initial ask

Thanks Ben — appreciate the clear scope.

We can support an on-prem package that integrates with a customer-managed S3 for cold-tier snapshots; there are a few technical knobs (KV cache eviction, snapshot cadence, and IAM model) we should confirm during the technical kickoff.

Marissa and Ben C. — looping you in for commercial alignment and pilot-credit handling. Priyom, can you lead the ops design and list any hard constraints (max snapshot frequency, required bandwidth for snapshot restoration, expected RTO)?

Propose: 30-minute alignment call tomorrow (Wed 11/11) at 10am PT if that works for everyone.

Next steps:
- Technical kickoff agenda (Priyom)
- Draft pilot SOW + credit split (Marissa)
- Security checklist (we'll ask for SOC/SIEM details)

Marcus
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Ben Andrews <ben@vectorspring.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 01:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Joint POC: pgvector on-prem + S3 cold tiering — pilot commercial outline

Ben / Marcus / team —

Thanks for the clear note. From a go-to-market and legal perspective, here's a pragmatic pilot outline we can start with:

- Pilot length: 6 weeks (deliverable: integration runbook + performance snapshot, plus one joint customer-facing tech note).
- Commercials: Redwood proposes to underwrite platform runtime credits for the pilot up to $12k; VectorSpring to commit engineering time and introduce 1 anchor customer for the pilot. We can do a revenue/credit split of 50/50 for any paid extensions, but pilot credits we put up front for momentum.
- Billing: Consolidated invoice for external storage (S3) to be paid by the customer; Redwood to provide monthly usage report. We will absorb up to $2k of storage egress during pilot if it helps burn-down risk.
- Security: VectorSpring to provide their SOC 2 type II scoping and a short architectural diagram showing where keys are held.

Action items for the kickoff call:
1) Priyom — list snapshot cadence options (daily, weekly) and expected size ranges.
2) Marcus — share pilot SOW template.
3) Ben (VectorSpring) — confirm anchor customer and any compliance constraints.

Attaching a quick pricing worksheet (redwood-pricing-estimate.xlsx) to show how we landed on the $12k pilot credit figure.

Marissa
Sr. Director, Partnerships & Sales — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood-pricing-estimate.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)

From: Ben Andrews <ben@vectorspring.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sandeep Rao <sandeep@vectorops.io>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Joint POC: pgvector on-prem + S3 cold tiering — pilot commercial outline

Marissa — thanks, that layout is helpful and fair. We're happy to:

- Commit engineering resources for the 6-week timeline and introduce one anchor customer (carrierX) pending NDA.
- Provide SOC 2 artifacts and a network diagram this afternoon.

One ask from our side: to accelerate procurement we prefer a single DocuSign covering the pilot SOW with a simple credit commitment clause. I'll drop a DocuSign link shortly (vectorspring-docusign-link.url). For the credit split on extensions, 50/50 is fine; for pilot credits we appreciate Redwood taking lead as you suggested.

Sandeep will join tomorrow's call for the technical deep-dive.

Regards,
Ben

Attachment: vectorspring-docusign-link.url (URL stub)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 10:30:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: Joint POC: pgvector on-prem + S3 cold tiering — pilot commercial outline

Folks — forwarding VectorSpring's confirmation. I support Marissa's commercial framing but want to flag two small asks before we sign:

1) Billing / consolidated invoice: legal needs a sentence that clarifies Redwood will bill only for platform credits; customer pays S3 directly, with Redwood providing a usage report.
2) Pilot acceptance criteria: performance baseline (99th pct latency for lookup under N qps) and snapshot restore time (goal: < 4 hours for a 500M-vector snapshot) should be explicit in SOW.

If everyone agrees I can approve the pilot SOW and sign once DocuSign lands. Priyom — any red flags on the restore time?

Marcus
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

raw_thread_summary: VectorSpring proposed a joint POC to validate Redwood Private + pgvector on-prem with S3 cold-tiering. Internal alignment covered tech knobs (snapshot cadence, restore time), commercial pilot credits and billing approach, and next steps: technical kickoff and DocuSign SOW. Redwood proposed underwriting pilot credits ($12k), VectorSpring to introduce anchor customer. Action items assigned to Priyom (ops design), Marissa (SOW drafting/commercials) and Marcus (SOW approval).
